title: विगतको समीक्षा नगरी पार्टीलाई अगाडि बढाउन सकिँदैन, नयाँ ढंगले जानुपर्छ : शंकर पोखरेल (भिडिओ)
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । नेकपा एमालेका महासचिव शंकर पोखरेलले विगतमा पार्टी सञ्चालन र राज्यसत्ता सञ्चालनका क्रममा भएका कमी कमजोरीको गम्भीर समीक्षा नगरी पार्टीलाई अगाडि बढाउन नसकिने बताएका छन्। प्रवासी नेपाली मञ्च अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय कमिटीको दोस्रो अधिवेशनलाई सम्बोधन गर्दै विगतका अनुभवको सही विश्लेषण गरेर मात्रै आगामी कार्यभार तय गर्नुपर्ने बताए। एमाले नेतृत्वमा बनेका दुईवटा नौ महिने सरकारबाहेक अन्य सरकारका पालामा पनि धेरै महत्त्वपूर्ण काम भए पनि जनमत विस्तार हुन नसकेको स्वीकारे। उनले भने, ‘२०७४ सालमा गठन भएको शक्तिशाली वामपन्थी सरकारका समयमा समेत वामपन्थी जनमत विस्तार हुन सकेन। समाजलाई परिवर्तन गर्ने उद्देश्य राखिएको पार्टीले शक्तिशाली सरकार निर्माण भएका बेला जनमत विस्तार गर्न किन सकेन भन्ने कुरा हाम्रो मूल्याङ्कनको विषय बन्नुपर्दछ। जब–जब हामी यो सत्यलाई मूल्याङ्कन गर्न सक्दैनौँ, तबसम्म समाजवाद निर्माणको ध्येय र उद्देश्य हासिल गर्न सक्दैनौँ।’ गत भदौ २३ र २४ गतेका घटनापछि एमालेको राजनीतिक जीवनमा ठूलो धक्का लागेको पनि बताए। पार्टीकै नेतृत्वमा सरकार रहेका बेला भएका ती घटनाले पार्टीको भविष्यबारे गम्भीर प्रश्न खडा गरेको बताए। उनले भने, ‘उक्त घटनापछि मुलुकको राजनीति प्रतिगमनतर्फ उन्मुख भइरहेको एमालेको विश्लेषण थियो। सोही विश्लेषणका आधारमा भू–राजनीतिक षड्यन्त्रको सामना गर्ने योजना बनाएर पार्टी अघि बढेको छ। फागुन २१ गते सम्पन्न निर्वाचनमा विगतमा पार्टीले गरेका राम्रा काम र भूराजनीतिक स्वार्थबारे जनतालाई सचेत गराएर जनमत पुनः आफ्नो पक्षमा फर्काउने अपेक्षा एमालेले गरेको भए पनि परिणाम अपेक्षाअनुसार आउन सकेन।’ प्रत्यक्ष निर्वाचनमा एमालेजस्तो पार्टी नौ सिटमा सीमित हुने कुरा कल्पनाभन्दा बाहिरको विषय भए बनाए। निर्वाचनमा पराजय भएपछि पार्टीलाई कसरी अगाडि बढाउने भन्नेबारे कार्यकर्ताबाट सुझाव संकलन गरी समीक्षा प्रतिवेदन तयार गरेको समेत बताए। उनले थपे, ‘त्यसैका आधारमा मात्रै अघि बढ्न नसकिने निष्कर्षसहित सचिवालय बैठकबाट पार्टी पुनर्गठनसम्बन्धी कार्यदल गठन गरियो। कार्यदलले कार्यकर्ताका सुझाव संकलन गरी सहमतिका आधारमा ४० बुँदे सङ्कल्प प्रस्ताव तयार गरेको छ। उक्त प्रस्तावको जगमा बसेको केन्द्रीय कमिटीको तेस्रो बैठकले पार्टी जीवनमा देखिएका समस्याहरूलाई सूत्रबद्ध गर्दै आगामी दिनमा अघि बढ्न दुई कार्यभार र १५ वटा काम तय गरेको छ।’ उनले पार्टीलार्ई नयाँ ढङ्गले अगाडि बढाउने प्रयत्न भइरहेको पनि बताए। विगतका अनुभव र कमजोरीको वस्तुनिष्ठ समीक्षा गर्दै नयाँ सन्दर्भअनुसार पार्टीलाई अघि बढाउनुपर्नेमा जोड दिए। Kathmandu. CPN-UML General Secretary Shankar Pokharel has said that the party cannot be moved forward without a serious review of the shortcomings and weaknesses experienced during the past course of party and state governance. Addressing the second convention of the International Committee of the Nepali Diaspora Forum, he said that the future work should be decided only after a proper analysis of past experiences. He admitted that although many important works were done during the tenure of other governments other than the two nine-month governments formed under the UML leadership, public opinion could not be expanded. He said, 'Even during the time of the powerful leftist government formed in 2074 BS, the leftist public opinion could not expand. Why a party whose aim was to change society could not expand public opinion when a powerful government was formed should be a matter of our evaluation. As long as we cannot evaluate this truth, we cannot achieve the goal and objective of building socialism.' He also said that the political life of the UML suffered a major setback after the incidents of Bhadra 23 and 24. He said that these incidents, which took place when the government was led by the party, raised serious questions about the future of the party. He said, "The UML's analysis was that the country's politics was heading towards regression after the said incident. Based on that analysis, the party has moved forward with a plan to confront the geopolitical conspiracy. Although the UML had hoped to turn public opinion back in its favor by making the people aware of the good work done by the party in the past and its geopolitical interests in the elections held on Falgun 21, the results did not come as expected." He said that it was unimaginable that a party like UML would be limited to nine seats in a direct election. He also said that he had prepared a review report after collecting suggestions from cadres on how to take the party forward after its defeat in the election. He added, "A task force on party reorganization was formed from the secretariat meeting with the conclusion that it was not possible to move forward on that basis alone. The task force has compiled suggestions from cadres and prepared a 40-point resolution proposal based on consensus. The third meeting of the Central Committee, held on the basis of that proposal, has formulated the problems seen in the life of the party and has set two tasks and 15 tasks to move forward in the coming days." He also said that efforts are being made to take the party forward in a new way. He emphasized the need to take the party forward in accordance with the new context by objectively reviewing past experiences and weaknesses.

दिनमा अघि बढ्न दुई कार्यभार र १५ वटा काम तय गरेको छ।’ उनले पार्टीलार्ई नयाँ ढङ्गले अगाडि बढाउने प्रयत्न भइरहेको पनि बताए। विगतका अनुभव र कमजोरीको वस्तुनिष्ठ समीक्षा गर्दै नयाँ सन्दर्भअनुसार पार्टीलाई अघि बढाउनुपर्नेमा जोड दिए। Kathmandu. CPN-UML General Secretary Shankar Pokharel has said that the party cannot be moved forward without a serious review of the shortcomings and weaknesses experienced during the past course of party and state governance. Addressing the second convention of the International Committee of the Nepali Diaspora Forum, he said that the future work should be decided only after a proper analysis of past experiences. He admitted that although many important works were done during the tenure of other governments other than the two nine-month governments formed under the UML leadership, public opinion could not be expanded. He said, 'Even during the time of the powerful leftist government formed in 2074 BS, the leftist public opinion could not expand. Why a party whose aim was to change society could not expand public opinion when a powerful government was formed should be a matter of our evaluation. As long as we cannot evaluate this truth, we cannot achieve the goal and objective of building socialism.' He also said that the political life of the UML suffered a major setback after the incidents of Bhadra 23 and 24. He said that these incidents, which took place when the government was led by the party, raised serious questions about the future of the party. He said, "The UML's analysis was that the country's politics was heading towards regression after the said incident. Based on that analysis, the party has moved forward with a plan to confront the geopolitical conspiracy. Although the UML had hoped to turn public opinion back in its favor by making the people aware of the good work done by the party in the past and its geopolitical interests in the elections held on Falgun 21, the results did not come as expected." He said that it was unimaginable that a party like UML would be limited to nine seats in a direct election. He also said that he had prepared a review report after collecting suggestions from cadres on how to take the party forward after its defeat in the election. He added, "A task force on party reorganization was formed from the secretariat meeting with the conclusion that it was not possible to move forward on that basis alone. The task force has compiled suggestions from cadres and prepared a 40-point resolution proposal based on consensus. The third meeting of the Central Committee, held on the basis of that proposal, has formulated the problems seen in the life of the party and has set two tasks and 15 tasks to move forward in the coming days." He also said that efforts are being made to take the party forward in a new way. He emphasized the need to take the party forward in accordance with the new context by objectively reviewing past experiences and weaknesses.

बताएका छन्। प्रवासी नेपाली मञ्च अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय कमिटीको दोस्रो अधिवेशनलाई सम्बोधन गर्दै विगतका अनुभवको सही विश्लेषण गरेर मात्रै आगामी कार्यभार तय गर्नुपर्ने बताए। एमाले नेतृत्वमा बनेका दुईवटा नौ महिने सरकारबाहेक अन्य सरकारका पालामा पनि धेरै महत्त्वपूर्ण काम भए पनि जनमत विस्तार हुन नसकेको स्वीकारे। उनले भने, ‘२०७४ सालमा गठन भएको शक्तिशाली वामपन्थी सरकारका समयमा समेत वामपन्थी जनमत विस्तार हुन सकेन। समाजलाई परिवर्तन गर्ने उद्देश्य राखिएको पार्टीले शक्तिशाली सरकार निर्माण भएका बेला जनमत विस्तार गर्न किन सकेन भन्ने कुरा हाम्रो मूल्याङ्कनको विषय बन्नुपर्दछ। जब–जब हामी यो सत्यलाई मूल्याङ्कन गर्न सक्दैनौँ, तबसम्म समाजवाद निर्माणको ध्येय र उद्देश्य हासिल गर्न सक्दैनौँ।’ गत भदौ २३ र २४ गतेका घटनापछि एमालेको राजनीतिक जीवनमा ठूलो धक्का लागेको पनि बताए। पार्टीकै नेतृत्वमा सरकार रहेका बेला भएका ती घटनाले पार्टीको भविष्यबारे गम्भीर प्रश्न खडा गरेको बताए। उनले भने, ‘उक्त घटनापछि मुलुकको राजनीति प्रतिगमनतर्फ उन्मुख भइरहेको एमालेको विश्लेषण थियो। सोही विश्लेषणका आधारमा भू–राजनीतिक षड्यन्त्रको सामना गर्ने योजना बनाएर पार्टी अघि बढेको छ। फागुन २१ गते सम्पन्न निर्वाचनमा विगतमा पार्टीले गरेका राम्रा काम र भूराजनीतिक स्वार्थबारे जनतालाई सचेत गराएर जनमत पुनः आफ्नो पक्षमा फर्काउने अपेक्षा एमालेले गरेको प्रश्न खडा गरेको बताए। उनले भने, ‘उक्त घटनापछि मुलुकको राजनीति प्रतिगमनतर्फ उन्मुख भइरहेको एमालेको विश्लेषण थियो। सोही विश्लेषणका आधारमा भू–राजनीतिक षड्यन्त्रको सामना गर्ने योजना बनाएर पार्टी अघि बढेको छ। फागुन २१ गते सम्पन्न निर्वाचनमा विगतमा पार्टीले गरेका राम्रा काम र भूराजनीतिक स्वार्थबारे जनतालाई सचेत गराएर जनमत पुनः आफ्नो पक्षमा फर्काउने अपेक्षा एमालेले गरेको भए पनि परिणाम अपेक्षाअनुसार आउन सकेन।’ प्रत्यक्ष निर्वाचनमा एमालेजस्तो पार्टी नौ सिटमा सीमित हुने कुरा कल्पनाभन्दा बाहिरको विषय भए बनाए। निर्वाचनमा पराजय भएपछि पार्टीलाई कसरी अगाडि बढाउने भन्नेबारे कार्यकर्ताबाट सुझाव संकलन गरी समीक्षा प्रतिवेदन तयार गरेको समेत बताए। उनले थपे, ‘त्यसैका आधारमा मात्रै अघि बढ्न नसकिने निष्कर्षसहित सचिवालय बैठकबाट पार्टी पुनर्गठनसम्बन्धी कार्यदल गठन गरियो। कार्यदलले कार्यकर्ताका सुझाव संकलन गरी सहमतिका आधारमा ४० बुँदे सङ्कल्प प्रस्ताव तयार गरेको छ। उक्त प्रस्तावको जगमा बसेको केन्द्रीय कमिटीको तेस्रो बैठकले पार्टी जीवनमा देखिएका समस्याहरूलाई सूत्रबद्ध गर्दै आगामी दिनमा अघि बढ्न दुई कार्यभार र १५ वटा काम तय गरेको छ।’ उनले पार्टीलार्ई नयाँ ढङ्गले अगाडि बढाउने प्रयत्न भइरहेको पनि बताए। विगतका अनुभव र कमजोरीको वस्तुनिष्ठ समीक्षा गर्दै नयाँ सन्दर्भअनुसार पार्टीलाई अघि बढाउनुपर्नेमा जोड दिए।

काठमाडौं । नेकपा एमालेका महासचिव शंकर पोखरेलले विगतमा पार्टी सञ्चालन र राज्यसत्ता सञ्चालनका क्रममा भएका कमी कमजोरीको गम्भीर समीक्षा नगरी पार्टीलाई अगाडि बढाउन नसकिने बताएका छन्।

प्रवासी नेपाली मञ्च अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय कमिटीको दोस्रो अधिवेशनलाई सम्बोधन गर्दै विगतका अनुभवको सही विश्लेषण गरेर मात्रै आगामी कार्यभार तय गर्नुपर्ने बताए। एमाले नेतृत्वमा बनेका दुईवटा नौ महिने सरकारबाहेक अन्य सरकारका पालामा पनि धेरै महत्त्वपूर्ण काम भए पनि जनमत विस्तार हुन नसकेको स्वीकारे।

उनले भने, ‘२०७४ सालमा गठन भएको शक्तिशाली वामपन्थी सरकारका समयमा समेत वामपन्थी जनमत विस्तार हुन सकेन। समाजलाई परिवर्तन गर्ने उद्देश्य राखिएको पार्टीले शक्तिशाली सरकार निर्माण भएका बेला जनमत विस्तार गर्न किन सकेन भन्ने कुरा हाम्रो मूल्याङ्कनको विषय बन्नुपर्दछ। जब–जब हामी यो सत्यलाई मूल्याङ्कन गर्न सक्दैनौँ, तबसम्म समाजवाद निर्माणको ध्येय र उद्देश्य हासिल गर्न सक्दैनौँ।’

गत भदौ २३ र २४ गतेका घटनापछि एमालेको राजनीतिक जीवनमा ठूलो धक्का लागेको पनि बताए। पार्टीकै नेतृत्वमा सरकार रहेका बेला भएका ती घटनाले पार्टीको भविष्यबारे गम्भीर प्रश्न खडा गरेको बताए।

उनले भने, ‘उक्त घटनापछि मुलुकको राजनीति प्रतिगमनतर्फ उन्मुख भइरहेको एमालेको विश्लेषण थियो। सोही विश्लेषणका आधारमा भू–राजनीतिक षड्यन्त्रको सामना गर्ने योजना बनाएर पार्टी अघि बढेको छ। फागुन २१ गते सम्पन्न निर्वाचनमा विगतमा पार्टीले गरेका राम्रा काम र भूराजनीतिक स्वार्थबारे जनतालाई सचेत गराएर जनमत पुनः आफ्नो पक्षमा फर्काउने अपेक्षा एमालेले गरेको भए पनि परिणाम अपेक्षाअनुसार आउन सकेन।’

प्रत्यक्ष निर्वाचनमा एमालेजस्तो पार्टी नौ सिटमा सीमित हुने कुरा कल्पनाभन्दा बाहिरको विषय भए बनाए। निर्वाचनमा पराजय भएपछि पार्टीलाई कसरी अगाडि बढाउने भन्नेबारे कार्यकर्ताबाट सुझाव संकलन गरी समीक्षा प्रतिवेदन तयार गरेको समेत बताए।

उनले थपे, ‘त्यसैका आधारमा मात्रै अघि बढ्न नसकिने निष्कर्षसहित सचिवालय बैठकबाट पार्टी पुनर्गठनसम्बन्धी कार्यदल गठन गरियो। कार्यदलले कार्यकर्ताका सुझाव संकलन गरी सहमतिका आधारमा ४० बुँदे सङ्कल्प प्रस्ताव तयार गरेको छ। उक्त प्रस्तावको जगमा बसेको केन्द्रीय कमिटीको तेस्रो बैठकले पार्टी जीवनमा देखिएका समस्याहरूलाई सूत्रबद्ध गर्दै आगामी दिनमा अघि बढ्न दुई कार्यभार र १५ वटा काम तय गरेको छ।’

उनले पार्टीलार्ई नयाँ ढङ्गले अगाडि बढाउने प्रयत्न भइरहेको पनि बताए। विगतका अनुभव र कमजोरीको वस्तुनिष्ठ समीक्षा गर्दै नयाँ सन्दर्भअनुसार पार्टीलाई अघि बढाउनुपर्नेमा जोड दिए।

Kathmandu. CPN-UML General Secretary Shankar Pokharel has said that the party cannot be moved forward without a serious review of the shortcomings and weaknesses experienced during the past course of party and state governance. Addressing the second convention of the International Committee of the Nepali Diaspora Forum, he said that the future work should be decided only after a proper analysis of past experiences. He admitted that although many important works were done during the tenure of other governments other than the two nine-month governments formed under the UML leadership, public opinion could not be expanded. He said, 'Even during the time of the powerful leftist government formed in 2074 BS, the leftist public opinion could not expand. Why a party whose aim was to change society could not expand public opinion when a powerful government was formed should be a matter of our evaluation. As long as we cannot evaluate this truth, we cannot achieve the goal and objective of building socialism.' He also said that the political life of the UML suffered a major setback after the incidents of Bhadra 23 and 24. He said that these incidents, which took place when the government was led by the party, raised serious questions about the future of the party. He said, "The UML's analysis was that the country's politics was heading towards regression after the said incident. Based on that analysis, the party has moved forward with a plan to confront the geopolitical conspiracy. Although the UML had hoped to turn public opinion back in its favor by making the people aware of the good work done by the party in the past and its geopolitical interests in the elections held on Falgun 21, the results did not come as expected." He said that it was unimaginable that a party like UML would be limited to nine seats in a direct election. He also said that he had prepared a review report after collecting suggestions from cadres on how to take the party forward after its defeat in the election. He added, "A task force on party reorganization was formed from the secretariat meeting with the conclusion that it was not possible to move forward on that basis alone. The task force has compiled suggestions from cadres and prepared a 40-point resolution proposal based on consensus. The third meeting of the Central Committee, held on the basis of that proposal, has formulated the problems seen in the life of the party and has set two tasks and 15 tasks to move forward in the coming days." He also said that efforts are being made to take the party forward in a new way. He emphasized the need to take the party forward in accordance with the new context by objectively reviewing past experiences and weaknesses.
